title: Meaningful Names
description: Write self-documenting code with clear, intention-revealing names.

data.text: **Meaningful names** are the foundation of clean code. Variables, functions, and classes should reveal their intent and purpose without needing comments.

data.title: Bad vs Good Naming
Key Takeaways
points: Names should answer why it exists, what it does, how it's used
Avoid single-letter names except for loop counters
Class names should be nouns, method names should be verbs
data.takeaway: Spend time choosing good names – it pays off in readability and maintainability.
